text: If in the evenings you have anxious states, and it is difficult for you to relax, try a simple trick: lie down in bed, and place a folded blanket or pillow on the pelvis area and the lower part of the abdomen (moderate weight, without discomfort). For 10 minutes breathe slowly, directing attention and breathing into the area of the body that is under pressure, gradually lengthening the exhalations. Gentle pressure gives the body a signal of safety, like a hug, only without dependence on someone else's presence. As a result, anxiety and stress decrease, and a deep feeling of being protected appears - "I am home".
